name: bake_into_a_pie_a_tapped_food_cannot_be_eaten
notes: The one Food's {T} (templates.food_token(), the R_FOOD ruling: '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.'), the part no other pack reaches: a pack cannot start an engine-made token tapped, and no verified card taps an artifact. Bake into a Pie destroys the Victim and makes the Food (card:14). With {2} in the pool another effect taps the Food (the tap op), and the menu then offers nothing: a tapped Food cannot pay its {T}, so it is not eaten (life 20, the Food stays, the {2} stays). Its {2}, the sacrifice and the 3 life are pinned by bake_into_a_pie_destroys_and_bakes_a_food.json. With both packs the gates' G3 counts the one Food proven (gates._verified_tokens, test_gates).
